title: Moved the agents from laptop to cloud server
what_changed: Hermes Agent, the open-source framework my agents run on, moved from a Linux virtual machine on my MacBook (M1 Max) to a cloud server running Ubuntu [G:0011]. The model gateway (9Router, which sends each request to a model) and the provider sync now run as system services on that server [G:0012].
why_it_matters: The agents keep working when the laptop is closed. Scheduled jobs and the daily progress report no longer depend on my machine being awake.
result: Gateway and sync were deployed as services on 21 Sep 2026 [G:0012].
lesson: The date of this move rests on a billing record and a boot log rather than my memory. I now log milestones to an append-only ledger with an ID and cite that ID when I write about them.

diagram.title: Before and after the move to a cloud server
diagram.desc: Left: the laptop setup, a Linux virtual machine on a MacBook (M1 Max) running Hermes Agent and the model gateway. Right: the cloud server running Ubuntu with Hermes Agent, and the model gateway and provider sync as system services. Arrow between them labelled moved 20 Sep 2026.
diagram.caption: The laptop setup on the left, the cloud server on the right. Dates from the billing record and boot log.
